decision.reason: [ev-d76b5a54d0e6] is only a link titled "Deprecated configuration options" pointing to the general configuration docs. It names no option, values key, flag or file setting. The rest of the section ([ev-ef5cca6f9d3b], [ev-3401df3ccc78]) covers storage and API deprecations and does not identify these options either. Deciding exposure, even whether the undecidable/evidence-gap leaf is the right answer instead of concrete values-key, cli-flag or ConfigMap text-line predicates, needs the content of the linked configuration page that lists which options are deprecated in 3.0.0.
